subject: prd/docgate
statement: When a commit is created in a clone with the hook path activated, the pre-commit hook shall run the merge-base-free gate verbs (lint-structure, validate-amendments, verify-generated, verify-rebase) and reject the commit on any defect.
rationale: generation must hold with no remote: the projection is committed fresh or not at all
fit_criterion: hook fixture: a stale projection rejects the commit naming the regenerate remedy; a fresh one passes; absent Go toolchain skips with the two-line notice
